title: Witness sketches of twisting black smoke streak, "1st position" to disappearance
description: Typed account of a small black cloud resembling an anti-aircraft shell burst that stretched into a wide streak, twisted and changed direction, and repeatedly vanished and reappeared. Below an agent's note that the witness drew the sketches, hand drawings show a compact squiggle labeled "1st position", a horizontal twisted band with an arrow annotated "width same - length estimated at 1 to 2 miles", and a curved bent streak captioned "Streak twisted and turned - suddenly disappeared", with a north arrow.
